title: SkyView Atlanta Observation Wheel Admissions Ticket
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience Atlanta from nearly 20 stories above the city aboard a 200-foot observation wheel located in the heart of downtown. Relax in a private, climate-controlled gondola while enjoying panoramic views of the Atlanta skyline, Centennial Olympic Park, and surrounding landmarks. Whether visiting during the day or taking in the city lights at night, it offers an unforgettable sightseeing experience for visitors of all ages.
